title: 2. Check conclusions one by one3. Do not assume anything extra

blocks.content:
Solved Example:

Statements:

All soldiers are disciplined.

Some disciplined are officers.



Conclusion:

Some soldiers are officers.

Logic:

Not necessarily true (no direct link)

Answer:

Conclusion does not follow

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Evaluate each conclusion independently without letting one influence another.
Strictly restrict your logic to the facts explicitly stated in the premise.
Avoid using external real-world knowledge or unstated assumptions to validate a conclusion.
Competitive exams frequently feature trap conclusions that are factually true in real life but do not logically follow from the given statement.
Always test each conclusion individually before evaluating combination options such as 'Either I or II follows'.
